name: ordinary sample contains only distinct input items
test:
import random
items=['alpha','beta','gamma','delta','epsilon']
result=sample_without_replacement(items[:],3,random.Random(469))
assert len(result)==3
assert len(set(result))==3
assert set(result)<=set(items)

name: empty and full sample boundaries
test:
import random
assert sample_without_replacement([1,2,3],0,random.Random(1))==[]
full=sample_without_replacement([1,2,3],3,random.Random(2))
assert len(full)==3 and set(full)=={1,2,3}
assert sample_without_replacement([],0,random.Random(3))==[]

name: two-of-three subsets have near equal frequencies
test:
import random
from collections import Counter
rng=random.Random(46902)
counts=Counter(frozenset(sample_without_replacement([0,1,2],2,rng)) for _ in range(6000))
assert set(counts)=={frozenset((0,1)),frozenset((0,2)),frozenset((1,2))}
assert all(abs(count/6000-1/3)<0.05 for count in counts.values()),counts

name: one-of-four values have near equal frequencies
test:
import random
from collections import Counter
rng=random.Random(46901)
counts=Counter(sample_without_replacement(['a','b','c','d'],1,rng)[0] for _ in range(8000))
assert set(counts)=={'a','b','c','d'}
assert all(abs(count/8000-0.25)<0.04 for count in counts.values()),counts
